Summary of a qremlModel object

summary.qremlModel.Rd

Summarises a model from qreml: the summary of summary.LaMaModel, plus the effective degrees of freedom and smoothing parameters of the smooth terms and diagnostics of the smoothness selection.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'qremlModel'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.qremlModel'
print(x, digits = max(3, getOption("digits") - 3), ...)

Arguments

object

model object of class "qremlModel"

...

additional arguments (not used)

x

object of class "summary.qremlModel"

digits

number of significant digits to print

Value

summary() returns an object of class "summary.qremlModel", extending "summary.LaMaModel" by edf, lambda and selection. print() returns x invisibly.
